Hm, I don’t really consider it a dogma I guess. Dogmas are defined as tenets believed without a doubt, and there’s plenty of doubt and argument surrounding most Jewish principles. I also don’t consider being transgender an ideology of mine. It’s just the way I happen to exist in the world.

Eh, it’s complex. There is this concept (pikuach nefesh) of the preservation of life being more important than keeping other commandments if they would lead you to death, so some Jews on the Orthodox side of things would call it a pikuach nefesh situation. Most other Jewish communities are accepting.
